name: Seamless.AI Company Structure
description: Structural inventory of the Seamless.AI Company record as returned by the Public API.
provenance: Derived from the provider-published OpenAPI at https://docs.seamless.ai/openapi.json (harvested 2026-08-14); field names, descriptions and examples are carried verbatim from that spec.

advertisingIntelligenceUrl.description: URL to advertising intelligence data for the company.

alexaScoreUrl.description: URL to Alexa score and rank details.

apiResearchId.description: The API research identifier for companies created through API research

phonesAiScores.description: Comma-separated AI confidence scores for each phone number in `phones`.

createdAt.description: Timestamp when this company record was created.

description.example: Seamless.AI is a sales intelligence platform.

domain.description: Primary website domain of the company.

googleFinanceUrl.description: URL to Google Finance data for the company.

googleResearchUrl.description: URL to Google research/profile results for the company.

industries.description: Comma-separated industry labels for the company.

intelUrl.description: URL to general company intelligence overview.

jobPostingsUrl.description: URL to job posting intelligence for the company.

localSportsTeamsUrl.description: URL to local sports context for the company location.

localWeatherUrl.description: URL to local weather context for the company location.

paidSearchIntelligenceUrl.description: URL to paid search intelligence details.

paidSearchKeywordsIntelligenceUrl.description: URL to paid search keyword intelligence details.

revenueRange.description: Revenue range bucket for the company.

searchMarketingIntelligenceUrl.description: URL to search marketing intelligence details.

secFilingsUrl.description: URL to SEC filings and regulatory disclosures.

seoResearchUrl.description: URL to SEO research and metrics.

socialMediaMentionsUrl.description: URL to social media mentions analytics.

socialMediaPostsUrl.description: URL to social media posts analytics.

socialPostsUrl.description: URL to general social posts aggregation.

topTechnologies.description: Comma-separated list of top detected technologies.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp when this company record was last updated.

websiteAudit2Url.description: URL to secondary website audit data.

whoisUrl.description: URL to WHOIS domain registration details.

wikipediaUrl.description: URL to the company Wikipedia page, when available.

newsAndEvents.description: Recent news articles related to the company.
